name: What happens during the final building inspection?

mainEntity.name: What happens during the final building inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Final inspection verifies completion per approved plans, tests systems like electrical and plumbing, checks life safety items, and issues a certificate of occupancy if everything passes.
